verdict.rationale: The dot keeps its own notes about preferences and uses them in later conversations, and its memory persists across ChatGPT, Slack, Teams and calls, so preferences you state can carry forward. This is agent-maintained memory, not a documented user-authored custom-instructions setting that is guaranteed to shape every response. Action rules in controls are a separate, adjacent feature and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: an explicit user-editable custom instructions or preferences field, documentation that these apply to every response, ways to view or edit stored preferences, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can set persistent custom instructions and preferences that shape every response

citations.quote: It also keeps its own notes about preferences, decisions, and ongoing work so it can use them in later conversations.
Changing where you talk to it doesn't start a new dot or reset its memory.
ask it to keep routine progress in ChatGPT and bring decisions to you in Slack.
